purpose: Typed frontend contract and fetch function for the backend-owned storefront home API.
businessRules: Home merchandising content is backend-owned and must not be duplicated as frontend constants.
Media assets include backend-versioned/cache-busted URLs, variants, dimensions, delivery mode, and LQIP metadata.
Media fields are nullable because archived or permanently deleted backend assets must not crash storefront rendering.
ProductCard includes backend-owned short and long customer-facing descriptions used by PDP and admin merchandising forms.
The home route uses no-store fetching so admin-managed storefront changes are visible without stale browser-owned data.
